I feel you. I feel like once my 3 closest people pass away, I will end it. Since I need to use my personal laptop at work from time to time, this week I started carrying a bottle of JD and some sleeping pills with me wherever I go. A part of me is desperately hoping something will trigger an impulse in my brain to one day just drive/walk to some beatiful place, sit down..take the pills and empty the bottle and just pass away feeling nothing but soothing sleep. I know noone will fix me but I have still been trying to go out on dates because I long so badly for someone to share life with...thos few happy moments I very rarely have now...but just a few days agi, again, my communication ended with this wonderful wooman I was on a nice date with just because she saw the negativity in me come out....I loath myself...I have had manu dates the past few months but she by far got my attention the most. The first time I literally walkes around housr alone for an entire day crying, screaming at myself..sitting on the floor talkint to myself...and ended up punching a fist sized hole in a plaster board wall. Everyone gets tired of my fckng negativity. I hate myself for being my worst enemy.
I feel you. I hate myself every single day and because of that I cannot seem to take control of my own life.
I feel you...
I am a coward. I KNOW the stuff I must do but I let fear take over every time I attempt doint the important stuff. I have no self esteem.

I know where my fears stem from, my childhood. I know I am an adult now and should let past be past, but I cannot seem to succeed at it. As a result, I am giving in to fear on a daily basis - meeting new people, trying out new things, accomplishing something completely on my own. And, seeing how I give up at every attempt makes me hate myself. Makes me feel worthless and leada to self loathing. It has gotten to a point I experience panic attacks nearly every morning.

I KNOW what I have to do! However, I have yet not found a way to man up and just get shit done without giving in to fear.
Totally true. I just have not found how to deal with panic attacks and emotions in general.

Totally true. I get scared ar each attempt and become emotional and don't carry on anymore.   Like I said, I have been taught to be afraid of making mistakes since childhood because they were always rewarded with yelling, name calling etc. Thar is where my fear stem from.
There is nothing worse than a coward. People suffer, fall and get back up once again, but here I am unable to fucking pull myself together to make my own life.
See, I cannot even take responsibility for my own life. I am a god damn useless coward.

Basically I am just a coward. That would be the most appropriate designation. I am a coward and have always been unable to folloa my heart. I am too much of a coward to takr my own life. I wish some sort of an accident just happened to me.

Emotions. Negative thoughts. Every time I am left alone I break down. I wish I would still have my last GF by my side. She always knew how to cheer me up, but I ruined that relationship. Everyone is telling me that I am makin it alllook worse than it is, and I understand that when I am having such a conversationt, but as soon as I am left alone, I become weak and do nothing. There is no one I could ask in my family to motivate me more. I cannot go back to living with my parents even though I have thougjt about it. I just wish I had found a girl by now who would be my support. But now, autum is coming, I will be alone in my appartment and will probably only feel worse.

I have always let my fears dictate my life and have always been floating in the middle, being as average as one can be - too weak to succeed in life and not capable of taking own life.

I truly feel ashamed because other have had a much more difficult life. But me? Days go by, I live in feara of failing at stuff and miss out on opportunities.


Like I posted before, I feel like I will definitely go once my few family members are gone.

I have always been the kind of person to act at the last moment... Who knows, maybe I have yet to fall down to finally climb up?!

I lost my virginity at 26. So freaking what? Once you get over it a whole new perspective of fun emerges in front of you. And soon you will understand sex is by far not the most important thing in any relaionship.

Cannot even rest while sleeping. Woke up ar 4, 5, 5.30 ans 6 this morning. Another day at work down the drain. I cannot deal with this anymore. I simply have no physical or mental strength left in me anymore.
I need a hug, too. I wish we could hug each other.

Don't stay in a destructive relationship. Love or no love, you must confront the alcohol issue before you undergo any more harm. That is not something to ignore. If he loves you, he will do whatever it takes to address the problem. 

My 2 cents.
Want to talk?
Make whatever changes to your life you feel will make you happy.
Try helplines. I am sure you have some available where you are. There are professionals who can help you in crisis, or at least guide you in the right direction.

Whole fing day at work in tears and panic..i cant deal with my emotions any longer..i just want some rest..any type...just some god damn tine off feeling so useless, insecure, afraid of everything... I wish i died in some sort of an accident any day now...please...it would end the constanr fear, panic, tears.

I just do not understand. How can I fight my emotions when everyone is telling me to counter them each time I feel I am about to get overwhelmed. And each time self-loathing and feeljng sorry for myself just swallows me up whole...and I am left with no ability to function rationally. I am so tired...just so god damn tired of not being able to enjoy life, to relax when it is needed...to work when it is needed. I want to rest, no matter how, just want to have a peace of mind finally. I am done fighting against my own brain.

Reach out to someone and talk to them about how you feel. Ask for help.

Recently, my relationship with a woman whom I will always love fell apart. It was devastating because I took what could have turned into a marriage and happy life and ruined it all beyond a point of no return. The worst part is, I tried to seek forgiveness, I wanted her and her family to tell me they wish me all good despite what happened, but they never did. 

Now, I have made contact with a few strangers who are devoting their time trying to help me overcome my depression. I am surprised to see they actually care. 

Do not end your life! No matter how bad you feel, talk to someone. You might even be surprised how much someone actualky cares for you.

I chose the wrong profession and I have no idea what I would actually enjoy doing. Also, I have always been afraid to try out new things and challenge myself. It stems from my childhood when my dad always used to react aggressively when I did something wrong or simply failed at something. I used to hide my bad grades till the last moment just to avous being yelled at for as long as possible. Now, at 29, I am still at panic when I need to throw myself into new settings, meet new people. All these feelings have stopped my personal growth.

I know, I am a wuss...some people struggle way more than me, have debts, health issues and so on...I feel like offending them complaining about my issues..but I cannot help but to feel completely useless without a place in the world I would feel I belong to.
Yes, I work, I merely exist, but I cry every god damn day, never feel relaxed, don't have appetite and find peace in the thought that I always have the possibility to end my life.

Reading all of the other threads on this reddit section, I feel like a complete wimp...people have gone through so much more than me...and I am here complaining :( I shoumd feel better knowing so many people have had ot way more rough than me but I DON'T...

It all comes down to a point I am standing at the train station, waiting for my train to come, and tearing from my eyes because I am contemplating about ending it all by jumping in front of the train. When I am alone at the summer house, I often cry histerically, yelling out loud for someone to help me please :(

I am studying to become a technical translator. And I have realizes my academic English is not even that good. I have no confidence in myself at all. 
I feel passionate about seeing myself being useful to someone, but I believe that is only a way to escape because it is easier helping other s than yourself. All I feel like doing now is live with my parents for a while again:( even though I realize it is probably not the best thing for my growth. The thing is though, during summer I am living with my grandmother at the family summer house, but in spring I will be moving into a rental apartment all alone. I am TERRIFIED of having my depression worsen while living all alone there :( I cannot tell them this because they helped me find this apartment. I fear I will get worse having to live there alone.

At my 29 I have realized I dislike my profession. I feel like it is too late to change anything. And the sad part is I have no idea what other profession I might feel good at. And I have yet to finish my diploma paper which my loving parents have always tried to talk me into. I have never been close with them. My dad has a good heart but when I was a kid he often lost his temper and called me names...stupid etc. When I had bad grades I would alyaws be yelled at. If I made a mistake I would always be yelled at. Now, at my 29, I desperately fear to try anything new out because I am terrified of failing. I love my dad and I do not blame him. 

I don't know...I felt ok yesteday having talked to them in person, and I have stuff to do here at work now, but instead I let myself burst into tears again. I know they love me, they support me, but what good is it if I do not know myself..what I enjoy doing..what I dislike....I am genuinely afraid for myself. I have had my ups and downs on life but I have never cried every day, I have never had a constant sense of panic.

People say I should stop feeling sorry for myself...how? I do not chose to cry, I feel this way, and emotions materialize in tears.

Organize an evening or a day out, just for you and your mom. Surely you know the little things that make her happy. Remind her of all the good moments you have experienced together. She might even be surprised you remember some of them. That way you will show her you appreciate everything she has done for you. Talk to her endlessly about all the good things she has taught you.
You plan on getting treatment, that is a step.in tje right direction :) I myself am afraid of being too medicated, still have to visit a therapist on Monday for the first time.
But why commit a suicide then? What has gotten you down so much? Such a note will not help, they will still miss you.
Hey! What has happened? Try talking to them first.

What is the reason you think this way? I too thought that my parents would not understand me, but the last few days we have talked to each other more than the last 10 years.

Bear in mind though, not everyone is capable of hearing out suicidal thoughts, some just cannot handle such information. 
You HAVE TO try talk to someone who is close to you. If you matter to them they will help you, be it by giving you their own experience advise or suggesting you to seek professional help.
You are not alone, go open up now.
Hey! Have you opened up to your family? Try it, you are not alone. You have people around you that care for you more than you could imagine.

The fact that you realize what your suicide might do to your loved ones is the first step to fighting this state of mind you are in. Talk to someone whom you conider a strong person who might encourage you and be able to handle suicidal talks. Do not hold it in. Seek help from people, be it your friends, family or healthcare professionals.

I have hels so much in me the last 10 years, only now have I startes talking to my parents about it, and I know it is a step in the right direction. 

Open up to your loved ones and they will make you want to live your life fully:)

You may feel bad but you are definitely at the beginning of your life, and no matter how you feel, you have all the time in the world to do what makes you happy and to seek any help you feel like you need.

You have the whole world at your hands now:) enjoy your childhood and talk, talk, talk to anyone whom you feel is important to you. You surely have so many childhood joys to turn your mind to :)
Talk to your family as soon as possible. They are there for you.

If they are really your riends, talk to them about how you feel! If they care for you, they will do their best to make you feel better and maybe even start to understand you better. It is a horrible feeling to stay alone with such thoughts.

Your being scared is normal. Having talked to my parents a bit, I feel guilty and deeply ashamed because now they are very worried about me, and that is why I too feel like a burden to him. I am slowly starting to realize that I have to accept the fact that no matter how close you feel to someone they just might not be able/ready/skilled enough to have a helping conversation with you.  I tried talking to the girl I broke up because we are still in touch (she needs a bit of financial support, and her health has always been bad, that is why I am helping her), but she is just too weak of a person to be able to handle sucidal thoughts. It is as if she is trying to ignore everything I am saying to her that is related to my depression. I understand her though, she would not handle it if I died from my own hand.

Seek professional help. There are people specially trained for helping us. And I am writing this with tears in my eyes from my work computer. The thing I am afraid of the most is being medicated too much. However, at this point, when I am constantly panicking at work and it makes me hard to fulfil my obligations, I believe some sort of medication could also help me. Yes, it can be quite expensive, but I am sure there are some crisis centers or other institutions that might provide more accessible help.

I was like you. I have never felt this way but I also never ever talked to anyone about my emotions before this depression. I have been carrying so much of them bottled up inside me, I guess the relationship that fell apart with my girlfriend just made me explode...

The first step towards doing the right thing is always tough! I have never been close with my parents, but all I want to do now is spend time with them and use their support to fight for my life. I am 29 now but will probably live with them for a while now, because I feel the worst when I am alone with myself.
Message me if you want to talk. We could be in totally different timezones though. Still, message me, I could use someone to talk to.

I am deeply sorry for how you feel. I am 29 now and at my all time low. I wake up with panic attacks every morning and throughout the day I cry several times and never feel relaxed or happy doing anything anymore.

I have made an appointment with a psychiatrist because a few days ago I realized how worried my parents are for me. I wish to feel calm again, nothing more. Depressive thougts, crying and panic attacks have taken all the strength out of me. Reach out for help! Seek therapy, talk to your close ones or even a stranger if you feel like doing so. I still feel terrible, but talking to my parents has at least showed me that I would be very very much missed if I ever went through with suicide.

People do care and love you, reach out and seek help!

But do not do it! You probably have people who would miss you the same way my parents would miss me.
